authority_fence.claim: This contract stabilizes the design only. It does not activate source syntax or claim implementation, publication, or product support.

syntax_compatibility.capture_item_production: CaptureItem ::= ("let" | "var") Identifier "=" Expr | CaptureMode Identifier | Identifier

bare_capture_item.meaning: A bare identifier retains its current capture-item meaning.
bare_capture_item.forbidden_reinterpretation: A bare capture item is not an implicit lexical-access marker and is not removed by this design.

capture_list_presence.absent: Qualified nonescaping lexical access may be inferred.
capture_list_presence.present_empty: The author asserts that the callable has no ancestor-frame dependencies. Module, type, and Prelude dependencies remain permitted.
capture_list_presence.present_nonempty: The list remains the explicit capture plan. Residual qualified lexical dependencies may coexist with explicit captures.

syntax_compatibility.representation_requirement: Absent, present-empty, and present-nonempty capture-list states remain distinct through CST, AST, HIR, and formatting.

semantic_model.core_rule: A proven-nonescaping synchronous callable may read an ancestor place at call time without acquiring that place into a capture environment.
semantic_model.lexical_dependency: The dependency is a call-time region requirement, not an environment capture.
semantic_model.closed_assertion: Present-empty capture syntax independently asserts an empty ancestor-frame dependency set.
semantic_model.mixed_state: A callable may have Explicit(CapturePlan) and RegionBound(RegionId) simultaneously.
semantic_model.region_ids: RegionId values are internal proof artifacts and are not exported in public API digests.

allowed: shared_nonconsuming_borrow whose lifetime is bounded by the call
rejected: borrow returned or stored beyond the call

admission.pure_rule: A pure lexical dependency must denote immutable data and must not introduce shared-state, resource, authority, or observable-effect access.
admission.scoped_rule: Passing a qualified lexical callable to the exact selected #scoped formal requires only a call-duration read requirement; it does not create a capture.
admission.guard_rule: Guard-owned lexical dependencies are excluded from this revision.

capture_preservation.explicit_capture_timing: Existing explicit capture acquisition remains creation-time.
capture_preservation.lexical_read_timing: Qualified lexical access reads the current ancestor place at call time.
capture_preservation.snapshot_contrast: An explicit copy capture remains a creation-time snapshot; lexical access remains live.
capture_preservation.bare_compatibility: Existing bare capture-item behavior is unchanged.
capture_preservation.same_place_precedence: one explicit capture removes lexical residue for that place; distinct qualified lexical dependencies may coexist

mir_backend_projection.mir_form: Use ordinary ancestor-rooted place reads with region proof metadata.
mir_backend_projection.static_link: A backend hidden static link is permitted but is not a source-observable event, capture environment, or public ABI surface.

diagnostic_design.bare_capture_compatibility: No diagnostic is emitted for the current bare capture-item meaning.

rules.statement: Qualified lexical access requires an exact closed proof route.
Qualified lexical access is synchronous, same-isolation, read-only, and nonconsuming.
Absent capture syntax permits inference; present-empty syntax asserts no ancestor-frame dependencies.
Explicit captures and residual lexical dependencies are orthogonal.
Lexical reads are live at call time; explicit capture timing is unchanged.
Bare capture items preserve their current meaning.
Qualified lexical access does not add an observable capture or MIR event.
Pure lexical dependencies are restricted to immutable, non-authority, non-resource data.
